svg.title: FMI 1, 2 and 3 Co-Simulation workflow
svg.desc: The shared path imports and instantiates a local FMU, initializes, advances, and releases it. FMI 1 exchanges initial values before initialization. FMI 2 and 3 exchange values in Initialization Mode. FMI 3 can also configure structural parameters and coordinate supported events and Clocks.

a.text: 1 Import
Application → libcosim importer: probe the version, extract the FMU and parse its description.
2 Instantiate
libcosim FMI instance → FMI Library → FMU shared library.
FMI 3
Optional Configuration Mode for structural parameters.
3 Initialize
FMI 1
Record times → exchange initial values → initialize; no Initialization Mode.
FMI 2
Set up experiment → enter Initialization Mode → exchange values → exit.
FMI 3
Enter Initialization Mode with times → exchange values → exit.
If enabled, process initial events; clocked FMUs initially remain in Event Mode.
4 Advance and observe
Execution → algorithm → simulator adapter → FMI instance → FMU; exchange values and observe.
FMI 3
Handle supported events and Clocks, step outcomes and optional callbacks.
Early return and termination can affect how far the simulation advances.
5 Finish and release
Terminate when permitted; release the FMI instance and its resources.

svg.text: FMI 2 and 3 state operations require the corresponding FMU capabilities.
Select a phase for its guide. Values and callbacks can flow back against the call direction.
FMI 3 Event Mode and Clock handling are subject to the supported Co-Simulation subset.
